Namibia Breweries recovered to N$3.05 after
sliding to a low of N$2.95 during the week. CIC also

Namibian Minerals Corp , which is also listed in

Officials said total turnover last week was 715,113 shares
worth N$6.74 million from 587,650 shares worth N$40.4 million.
